game_title: Phone Book Rescue – Snowline Trail Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Frost Peaks – Snowline Trail, the trail at the snowline: the sherpa guide must handle avalanches while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Phone Book Rescue: Add and update dictionary entries as contacts change.
theme: Frost Peaks – Snowline Trail: the trail at the snowline
core_gameplay_loop: In Snowline Trail, repeat each round: Add and update dictionary entries as contacts change. Each round, avalanches strike the rescue sled, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the contacts value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the rescue sled from avalanches in Snowline Trail: keep the contacts meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 50-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: contacts drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 50-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 3 (intro tier): Phone Book Rescue
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Phone Book Rescue' (Week 8 slot 8), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Snowline Trail'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how contacts changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against avalanches in Snowline Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 50 seconds while contacts > 0.
